answers.question: While gap questions and application data are loading (3 parallel API calls), what should the page show?
answers.answer: Skeleton cards (3-4 placeholder question cards with shimmer)

answers.question: If the GET /jobs/{jobId}/gap-questions API call fails, what should the page display?
answers.answer: Inline error banner above question list with Retry button

answers.question: When no gap questions exist yet (before generation), what should the page show? The 'Generate Questions' button is not visible in the screenshots.
answers.answer: Gap questions are generated as a product of submitting a New Application. Once the user submits the Job listing, the Company URL and their CV, the LLM conducts a web research report and generates gap questions. If no gap questions are generated from this process, show a message directing user back to the hub to retry submitting their application. There was an error and they can contact the site administrator.

answers.question: The screenshots show a rich text toolbar (B, I, U, bullet list, numbered list). Which library should power this editor?
Should the rich text answer be stored as HTML, Markdown, or plain text? The current API stores plain text in the response field.
When the user clicks 'Save' on a single question, should it save just that one answer or all answers at once?
answers.answer: Save only the current question's answer (individual POST per question)

answers.question: The current code has destination radio buttons (CV_IMPACT / INTERVIEW_MVP_ONLY) and impact/probability badges. These are absent from all screenshots. Should they be removed?
answers.answer: Keep both features but show them in a collapsed/advanced section

answers.question: On mobile viewports, how should the gap analysis question cards adapt?
answers.answer: Same layout, full-width cards stacked vertically

answers.question: Should the rich text editor support pasting formatted text (from Word, Google Docs, etc.), or strip formatting on paste?
answers.answer: Strip but keep basic formatting (bold, italic, lists only)

answers.question: Should the rich text editor toolbar buttons have ARIA labels, and should the editor area have a descriptive aria-label linking it to the question?
answers.answer: Yes — toolbar buttons get aria-labels, editor gets aria-labelledby pointing to question text

answers.question: New strings include: 'Gap Analysis Questions', 'Answer some questions to fill in gaps...', 'X out of Y answered', 'Answer', 'Edit', 'Save', '← Back'. Should Hebrew translations be added?
answers.answer: Yes — add Hebrew translations for all new strings

answers.question: When a user is editing one question and clicks 'Answer' on a different unanswered question, what should happen to the first editor?
answers.answer: Prompt to save or discard the first before opening the second

answers.question: The header shows 'Credits: 1 / 3'. Does this refer to gap analysis credits, overall application credits, or trial-plan credits? Which API field and endpoint provides this data?
answers.answer: Trial-plan application credits only. Call GET /users/me/usage and read applications.used (numerator) and applications.remaining; derive total as used + remaining. The constant 3 comes from TRIAL_LIMIT_APPLICATIONS in trial_service.py. Data flow: useUserContext hook → api.getUsage() → AppHeader renders '{used} / {total} applications'. For paid subscribers isUnlimited=true and the header shows 'Unlimited' instead.

answers.question: Should a 'Generate Questions' button exist anywhere on the gap-analysis page as a fallback for the empty state?
answers.answer: No 'Generate Questions' button anywhere on the page. Questions are always pre-generated before the user arrives here; the empty/error state instead directs the user back to the hub.

answers.question: When a user saves a question without expanding the collapsed advanced section (destination radio), what value should be sent for the destination field in POST /jobs/{jobId}/gap-responses?
answers.answer: Send hardcoded default CV_IMPACT when the user has not interacted with the collapsed section.

answers.question: Are the impact and probability badges read-only or interactive? Should they be visible in the collapsed header row before the advanced section is opened?
answers.answer: Read-only display badges showing LLM-assigned values. They must be visible even when the advanced section has never been opened — render them in the collapsed header row as a summary.
